messages:
SRE-bot: Pager — service: routing-pool-backpressure, endpoint: /v1/embeddings, sym: 503 spikes, 3 customers affected, suspected: full-backoff on dedicated-pool-3. severity: sev2
Priya: Seeing the spike in Grafana, p95 latency to 8s, error rate ~12% on that pool. Routing fallback didn't kick for a subset. I’m attaching traces in #eng-runtime.
Jorge: Oncall here. Taking ownership of live mitigation. Priya can you confirm whether autoscaler showed any pending scale events?
Priya: Autoscaler queued, but it failed to attach new instances due to image pull timeout in region-eu-west-1. Logs: `kubelet: image pull failed "timeout"`
Jorge: Ok — short-term: I'll enable manual routing to spare-pool-1 and set fallback to smaller-emb-model-v2 for non-SLA tenants. Priya — can you memo the customer-impact list?
Priya: Done — 3 customers: acme-app (SLA tier 2), beta-analytics (default), internal-eval (internal). Acme-app saw ~25% requests fail during window.
Marta: Thx. I’ll ping Support to notify ACME and coordinate mitigation comms. Sam (Product) — heads up for potential customer outreach.
Ken: Manual reroute applied, verifying traffic shift… p95 back to 1200ms on spare-pool, error rate down to 1.5%. Good mitigation.
Jorge: Solid. I’ll keep page ownership until we hand to postincident. Priya — please kick off a postmortem doc and schedule the postincident review for next Tue 09:30 PT if that works.
Priya: Creating postmortem doc now: https://docs.internal/postmortems/2248500001-routing-backpressure. Scheduling invite to eng-runtime, eng-sre, product, support.
Marta: Quick notes for the postmortem agenda: timeline, root causes (image registry timeout + fallback policy gap), immediate mitigations, and action items with sizing estimates.
Jorge: Action items I see so far (assign draft here):
- A1: Fix image-pull fallback & retry logic in autoscaler (owner: Jorge) — estimate: M (2d)
- A2: Add integration test for routing fallback triggering under partial pool failure (owner: Priya) — estimate: S (8h)
- A3: Update routing policy to prefer spare pools earlier for latency-sensitive tenants (owner: Ken) — estimate: M (1.5d)
- A4: Incident playbook update & support runbook for customer comms (owner: Marta) — estimate: S (4h)
- A5: Alerting tune: add synthetic check for image registry slowness (owner: Sam (Product) / eng-infra) — estimate: L (1w)
Priya: I’ll publish those into the postmortem page and add a tracking table column for quarter tie-in.
Sam (Product): For prioritization: A1 and A3 map to Reliability OKR for Q2 (reduce production P1/P2 recurrence). Please tag tasks accordingly so PMO can include in sprint planning.
Marta: For severity-based prioritization: mark A1 and A3 as high priority (P0/P1), A5 as P2, A2/A4 as P3.
Ken: Quick question: do we want to treat A2 (integration test) as blocker to rolling A3? I’d prefer we run the test first in staging.
Jorge: Not a hard blocker — A3 can be rolled to canary but require A2 pass for full rollout. Mark dependency on postmortem tracking.
Priya: Postmortem invite set for Tue 09:30 PT, invites sent. I added owners and estimates to the remediation board: https://boards.internal/incident-remediation/2248500001
SRE-bot: Reminder: create remediation epics with due dates aligned to estimates and tag with `inc-2248500001`.
Priya: Will do. Proposed due dates: A1 by end of week+1 (2d work + QA), A3 canary in 10d, full roll in 14d, A5 in sprint-6. Adding to quarterly plan as Q2 reliability work.
Sam (Product): I'll push for A1/A3 in next sprint planning; will surface cost tradeoffs for spare-pool prioritization.
Marta: I'll follow up on customer comms drafts postmortem and confirm ACME message.
Jorge: Wrapping up now. Thanks all — leaving final handoff notes on the postmortem doc. I’ll mark the page as incident-resolved once we verify no regression in 24h. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Noted. Closing incidents channel thread, will update when actions are in tracking board. :+1:
